description: Boss instrument: the Captain’s phrase on a beat that will not hold still.
notes: The **treatment arm** of the read condition ([ADR-010](../../docs/DECISIONS.md)): the Captain's room, the Captain's phrase, and a beat that will not hold still.

Everything the player can see is the control's — same room, same silhouette, same colour, same music bed, same arena theme. Only `telegraphJitterMs` moves, which is what makes the pair a measurement of *the beat* rather than of anything the eye can name. `tests/captain-read.test.ts` asserts the parity field by field.
